banks.description: Authoritative user outcomes, constraints and acceptance criteria from master spec linked to executable tasks.
banks.current_state: Initial product spec and 12 scoped backlog records; needs decomposed route/role acceptance criteria.
banks.tradeoffs: A compact ledger improves traceability; full requirements remain in the spec until each slice is scheduled.

banks.description: Differentiation hypotheses and later options with evidence state, not product promises.
banks.current_state: Cross-provider operations, migration parity and incident evidence are hypotheses.
banks.applicability: P0 product strategy and later planning
banks.source: Master specification; competitor pages cited in docs/RESEARCH/COMPETITORS.md
banks.tradeoffs: Combining workflows could deliver agency value but raises scope, integration and security cost.

banks.description: Per-provider auth, operation support, roles, scopes, limits and provenance.
banks.current_state: Primary-source constraints documented for Gmail, Graph, cPanel and OAuth; no live probe.
banks.source: Official provider/API docs listed in docs/RESEARCH/PROVIDER_LIMITS.md
banks.tradeoffs: Capability probing adds connector complexity but prevents false privilege claims.

banks.description: Stable adapter contracts, typed capability states, rate/backoff, cursors and webhook reconciliation.
banks.current_state: Contracts are requirements only; no provider adapter exists.
banks.source: Master spec and official provider docs
banks.tradeoffs: Adapter boundary costs initial design time; isolates API/version differences and mockability.

banks.description: Consent, sync, safe send, migration, install, incident and AI-action state flows.
banks.current_state: Seven flow diagrams capture control boundaries; diagram/code parity remains pending.
banks.tradeoffs: Separate flows make authorization and recovery clearer; keep each synchronized with implementation.

banks.description: Bounded contexts, service boundaries, trust edges, deployment, diagrams and ADRs.
banks.current_state: Portable modular monolith proposed; exact stack and DB worker proof pending.
banks.source: ADR-0001 and master spec Part VI
alternatives: single web process with no worker
banks.tradeoffs: Monolith is simpler to self-host and evolve; preserve contracts to allow later splitting when measured.

banks.description: Design tokens, visual direction, accessibility and interaction principles.
banks.current_state: Dense-neutral ops-console direction selected for synthetic prototype; no complete library/a11y audit.
banks.tradeoffs: Status-first dense layout helps operations; must validate readability, mobile behavior and a11y.

banks.description: Route, role, device and state coverage with implementation parity evidence.
banks.current_state: Overview/provider inventory prototype only; full screen-state matrix remains a P0 gap.
banks.source: Master spec Part V and knowledge/screens/screen-matrix.csv
banks.tradeoffs: Full matrix costs more effort but makes permission and failure states explicit.

banks.description: Tenant-scoped relational entities, identifiers, lifecycle, retention and encryption classification.
banks.current_state: Conceptual data groups and constraints documented; no production schema/migration.
banks.source: Master spec Part VI and docs/DATA_MODEL.md
alternatives: tenant key on every owned row/object
banks.tradeoffs: Explicit tenant keys and indexes require careful migration but make ACLs and audits testable.

banks.description: Versioned API, connector capability results, error taxonomy, webhooks and idempotency.
banks.current_state: Requirements scoped; no API server/OpenAPI contract exists.
banks.tradeoffs: Contracts improve external integration and compatibility but must stay aligned with implementation.

banks.description: Threats and mitigations for auth, tenant access, secrets, SSRF, MIME, outbound actions, AI and logs.
banks.current_state: Initial threat boundaries drafted; no production auth or security audit.
banks.applicability: All phases; gates provider data release
banks.source: Master spec Parts VII and VIII; RFC 9700
banks.tradeoffs: Designing controls early reduces unsafe rework; security certification remains separate evidence.

banks.description: Migration manifests, parity, source retention, encrypted backup, restore and rollback.
banks.current_state: Requirements and flow diagram only; no data transfer or backup code.
banks.source: Master spec sections 20-21 and backlog P6
banks.tradeoffs: Source preservation raises temporary storage/cost but prevents irreversible loss.

banks.description: Model adapters, user consent, redaction, grounded evidence, evaluations and action scopes.
banks.current_state: Requirements only; no model API, private-mail processing or AI action exists.
banks.applicability: P8 and optional earlier summaries only after consent design
alternatives: send raw mail to a model
opt-in redacted provider with draft-only actions
banks.tradeoffs: Model utility is balanced against data exposure, cost, prompt injection and provider terms.

banks.description: Single-flight commands, leases, backoff, budgets, runbooks, checkpoints and observability.
banks.current_state: Local commands and basic CI exist; production job orchestration/runbooks do not.
alternatives: bounded idempotent leases and explicit budgets
banks.tradeoffs: Durable coordination adds system complexity but prevents duplicate work and provider mutation.

banks.description: Dated comparative facts, pricing evidence, differentiation hypotheses and limitations.
banks.current_state: Four official products researched; hosting admin/MSP/backup categories and user interviews remain open.
banks.tradeoffs: Narrow verified claims avoid false differentiation but leave a broader validation task.

banks.description: Primary technical research citations, applicability, assumptions and limits.
banks.current_state: OAuth RFC 9700 and official protocol/provider docs reviewed; distributed recovery papers remain queued.
banks.tradeoffs: Time-boxed topics avoid endless research while documenting remaining unknowns.

banks.description: Candidate stacks, components, deployment modes, weighted comparisons and ADR outcomes.
banks.current_state: Preliminary scorecard recommends React/Vite + NestJS + Postgres; exact ORM, queue and storage need prototype proof.
banks.tradeoffs: Scores are judgment not measured; keep the decision reversible until vertical-slice data exists.

banks.description: Synthetic provider behavior, adversarial cases, test IDs and evidence paths.
banks.current_state: Prototype has 4 passing synthetic tests; full connector/mailbox fixtures are test-strategy requirements only.
alternatives: versioned synthetic fixture and result ledger
banks.tradeoffs: Fixtures support repeatable failures; must not include unauthorized real mail.

banks.description: Measured workloads, latency/throughput budgets, capacity, storage and AI costs.
banks.current_state: No production benchmark or numeric SLO exists.
alternatives: measure representative workload then set target
banks.tradeoffs: Waiting for representative workload prevents false promises but postpones scale planning.

banks.description: Deployment support, version matrix, artifacts, security and release evidence.
banks.current_state: Local prototype only; no production artifact or supported VPS baseline.
banks.source: docs/DEPLOYMENT_MATRIX.md, docs/INSTALLATION.md and master spec Part VIII
banks.tradeoffs: Reproducible release requires database/worker operations beyond the current prototype.
